pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
name: Tuen Mun
scopeLimits: Public Lands Department CSDI Lot polygons in the Tuen Mun neighborhood. The dataset represents land sold or granted for specified uses and does not form a complete parcel fabric. Thirteen aligned 0.001° cells and four adjacent pans passed the real adapter with source count and object-ID manifests; a 29-window source check plus footprint neighbors yielded 127 distinct full polygons. All 127 fresh LotCSUID equality reads reproduced IDs and geometry, a valid absent ID returned empty, forced three-row object-ID batches completed, and the exact-WUP parcel passed full footprint retrieval and actual runtime proposal binding. GEOS in EPSG:32650 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry or positive-area overlaps above 0.01 m² in the bounded union. One conservative source bbox candidate lies about 0.04 m outside a cell; full geometry is preserved, with no snapping or clipping. Offset paging omitted that candidate, and multi-ID IN reads returned HTTP 403; the enabled descriptor uses object-ID manifests and one native LotCSUID equality per ID. Only LotCSUID, OBJECTID transport keys and LotID labels accompany geometry. Citywide completeness and identity continuity across quarterly replacements remain unverified. Published legal and survey notices are retained as scope information.
registryBasis: Hong Kong Lands Department publishes the Lot dataset through CSDI and its official metadata identifies Tuen Mun within the digital land-boundary map coverage. The queried Lot dataset is a subset-style land-lot layer, not all parcels.

officialSources.observation: Official data.gov.hk record identifies the Lands Department Lot dataset, CSDI API, quarterly update frequency, and describes lots as land granted or sold for specified uses rather than all parcels.

Layer metadata was inspected before feature query: layer 0 Lot, Polygon geometry, EPSG:4326-supported output; fields OBJECTID, Shape__Length, Shape__Area, LotID, LotCSUID; maximum record count 3,000. Only OBJECTID and LotID requested.
Official iC1000 metadata says current digital land-boundary maps cover Tuen Mun and are updated; mapped boundaries are approximate and field survey is needed.
Official Lot Index API documentation describes a separate GML query service for lots/GLAs/STTs with bounded bbox requests.
